name: triage-suspicious-login-agent
description: LoginTriage — a Flue agent that triages suspicious Cloudflare Access logins and reports to Slack.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: A [Cloudflare API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with **Account Intel: Read** and **Access: Audit Logs: Read**.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare [account ID](https://dash.cloudflare.com/), found in the dashboard sidebar.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Leave blank for now. Add after creating your Slack app: the `xoxb-` bot token with the `chat:write` scope.

SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Leave blank for now. Add after creating your Slack app: the signing secret that verifies incoming webhooks.
